blocks.text: Product Description               Now more than ever, you’re naturally seeking to nourish your baby with the perfect foods & supplements. Discover Wholemega for Moms fish oil supplement from New Chapter, expertly formulated with 17 Omega fatty acids to support your baby's healthy brain and eye development—and also support your own positive mood, calm & heart health.* For prenatal DHA during pregnancy or an Omega supplement to take when nursing, Wholemega for Moms includes essential Omega-3s as well as natural Vitamin D3. *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.                  Amazon.com

Omega-Rich Fish Oil for Mother & Baby ...Wholemega Prenatal delivers all the rich Omegas from naturally pure Wild Alaskan Salmon Oil for the benefit of mom and baby. It’s an excellent source of whole DHA, a “good fat” that’s important for fetal development of the brain and retina during pregnancy and throughout the first year of life.* The complete basket of broad-spectrum Omegas, including Omega-3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9’s, serves to nourish brain, heart, eye, and kidney tissues, and has been shown to benefit cardiovascular, immune system, brain, and digestive health.* Wholemega Prenatal is delivered in small, easy-to-swallow capsules for mom’s comfort and convenience. Taking Wholemega Prenatal every day for a week (2g/day) provides the same amount of omega fatty acids as three servings of Wild Alaskan Salmon.Try New Chapter’s other Wholemega formulas for key areas of health!Other Omega-Rich Fish Oils for...  Overall Health*Healthy Heart*Healthy Joints* Alertness and Calm*
Wholemega Whole Fish Oil, Wholemega Cardio, Wholemega Flex, and Wholemega Focus are formulated for specific health areas.

Caution: As with any dietary or herbal supplement, you should advise your healthcare practitioner of the use of these products. If you are nursing, pregnant, or considering pregnancy, you should consult your healthcare practitioner prior to using these products.  *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. These products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

A Whole, Naturally Pure Fish Oil with a Clear Difference If you take a “purified” fish oil capsule, you’re not getting the 17 whole, natural omegas and the naturally occurring antioxidants and vitamins your body looks for—the ones only a whole, naturally pure, extra-virgin fish oil like Wholemega Whole Fish Oil can deliver. That’s because conventional “purified” fish oils use chemical processing that can destroy what Nature created. The truth is, the best sources of vital omegas also happen to be the purest—wild, cold-water fish like the Wild Alaskan Salmon. Wholemega fish oil delivers 100% Wild Alaskan Salmon from the pristine, protected waters of Alaska directly to you. In fact, taking the daily serving of Wholemega (2g/day) for a week provides the same amount of whole omega fatty acids as three servings of Wild Alaskan Salmon.The Health Benefits of Whole Omegas

The omega fatty acids in fish oil offer many health benefits. Fish oil is rich in Omega-3’s and, according to the American Heart Association, salmon has more than twice the Omega-3 fatty acids as other seafoods. Omega 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9’s are fatty acids found in wild fish and often referred to as “good fats.” Why so good? Primarily because omegas are present and play an important role in every human cell. Specifically, omega fatty acids serve to nourish brain, heart, eye, and kidney tissues.* They have been shown to benefit cardiovascular, immune, and digestive health in addition to supporting a healthy metabolism and inflammation response.*Heart Healthy Fish Oil with Clinical ResultsNew Chapter’s Wholemega Whole Fish Oil has been clinically shown to improve triglyceride levels—a key marker of heart health—in as few as 14 days.* Triglycerides are a form of stored fat found in the bloodstream and body tissues. Keeping these levels in a healthy range is important for helping support the health of the heart and blood vessels.* Pure vs. “Purified”—the Difference is Clear The dull, yellow hue of conventional fish oils is symbolic of products that have been molecularly distilled, fractionated, isolated, and processed (“purified”). Conventional fish oils are “purified” to remove toxins, PCB’s, or heavy metals and to “standardize” for only Omega 3 levels. This heavy processing can strip them of Nature’s whole basket of Omega fatty acids, as well as other beneficial nutrients.Wholemega is 100% Wild Salmon Oil, from protected Alaskan fisheries harboring some of the world’s cleanest stocks of fish. The result is pure, extra-virgin fish oil (think of fine olive oil) that retains Nature’s whole complement of vital Omegas, as well as natural Vitamin D3 and a rich amber color from the antioxidant Astaxanthin.

Wildly Pure Whole Fish Oil Plus Tonic Herbs New Chapter is the recognized leader in delivering the holistic benefit of supercritically extracted natural herbals that target and support key health conditions. They are proud to introduce a pioneering new family of formulas that combines tonic herbs with whole fish oil; maximizing the properties of both. Each new formula combines a clinical dose of Wholemega Whole Fish Oil with full-spectrum herbs that support key areas of health.All Wholemega formulas contain Wild Alaskan Salmon Oil that comes from protected, recognized sustainable fisheries. This extra-virgin oil comes from only 100% wild fish stocks and does not include genetically modified or farmed salmon. All of New Chapter’s herbal blends are reviewed and Non-GMO Project Verified.  About New Chapter

New Chapter was founded out of a passion to promote health through innovative formulations made with 100% real foods and with a commitment to always make a contribution—to innovate—to provide a new chapter in nutritional supplementation, not simply offer another copy of the same thing. Mother Nature is a powerful healing force, and New Chapter’s humble mission is to Deliver the Wisdom of Nature to all people interested in natural wellness.New Chapter’s products are known for their purity, efficacy, and ingenuity. They are regarded as industry pioneers in cultured whole-food complexed vitamins and minerals, making their whole-food complexed nutrients a superior alternative to synthetic isolates. Likewise, they have championed the use of supercritical CO2 extraction, which creates a broad-spectrum yet powerfully concentrated herbal extract—but without the use of high heat or toxic chemical solvents. And New Chapter carries the distinction of being the supplement industry’s first organic manufacturer to produce vitamins and minerals certified to be made with organic ingredients. New Chapter has long been committed to rooting out genetically modified organisms (GMOs). More than 85% of their products have already been granted verified status by the Non-GMO Project. They are the first and only vitamin and supplement company to achieve this extraordinary depth of verification, and they are intent on achieving 100% Non-GMO Project verification for their entire line of whole-food complexed vitamins, minerals, and herbal supplements. They are proud to be the leading advocate of the non-GMO movement within the dietary supplement industry. Committed to organic, sustainable, and sensible practices, New Chapter works with recycled, recyclable, and ecologically sensitive materials and devotes a portion of its after-tax profits to environmental conservation.
